label: The Writer
tagline: A room that breathes with the cadence of the current paragraph
cluster_explainer: Practitioners read the engine for what it does to attention over time, with zero tolerance for popups or nudges.
demo_highlights: Torus reads as cycles within cycles — paragraph cadence, not chapter arc
Mid-band tracks the breath body where the sentence's emotional weight actually lands
Muted purple (#9c89b8) reads as typography-coded, not as illustration
Smooth envelope at 0.6 moves with the draft — gradual build and release, never a beat drop
No export, no analytics, no memory — the page is a room that doesn't watch you write
